liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments were stable at {{cash_like@FY2025}}, leaving cash liquidity to revenue at {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, so the near-term maturities absorb a large part of the cash balance and leave little headroom without new funding.
The group placed senior unsecured bonds under its EMTN programme and exercised the extension option on its Air France-KLM and Air France credit facility, bringing that maturity to 2029.

Customer prepayments rose, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}} and advance ticket cover at {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, the lowest of the peer group.

watch_items.text: Cash liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, the lowest of the network group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2025}}).

Maturities: debt due within one year of {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}} rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} and sits against cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2025}}, so refinancing is needed to cover the balance.

Cash generation: FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}} is the weakest of the group ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2025}}) against a peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}, with capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}} above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2025}}, so a larger share of the cash balance is refundable if bookings slow.
